message.reasoning:
The primary ratio from Monte Carlo (0.7315) lines up reasonably with the analytic value (0.7292), about a 0.3% difference, likely from geometric factors like the 1/cos term and pyramid shape. The total ratio comes out near 1.15, putting the scattered fraction of fluence at roughly 36%.

This scatter-to-primary ratio of about 0.57 is plausible for Co-60 at 10x10 field size, SSD 100, since literature values around 5cm depth suggest something in the 0.5-0.6 range — the scattered fluence here includes plenty of low-energy Compton photons. For statistics, I'm planning to run batches of 2e6 histories and aggregate up to around 1.6e7 total (roughly 100 seconds), saving the tallies to files so I can also extract depth-dose data afterward.
